hero.headline: Ship from Brazil. Stop answering "where is my order?"
hero.subline: Every shipment has a number and a status updated by someone on our team. You and your customer can check it any time.
hero.abVariant: The hard part of exporting isn’t the freight. It’s the silence.

howItWorks.heading: Eight stages, from registration to delivery
howItWorks.body: Every stage change is recorded with date, time, and location. You see the whole sequence, not just the current stage.

whyUs.heading: Three things we do differently
whyUs.item1: Status updated by people, not by an automated feed. When something stalls, someone writes the reason into the record.
whyUs.item2: Full visible history, delays included. No two weeks of “processing” without an explanation.
whyUs.item3: Your own access. Sign in and check all your shipments without emailing or messaging anyone.

quoteBand.heading: Have a shipment to send?

faq.q1: Where do I find my tracking number?
faq.a1: It is sent by email when the shipment is registered, in the format DCBR-0000-000000. If you have an account, all your numbers appear in the dashboard.
faq.q2: How often is the status updated?
faq.a2: At every stage change. Updates are made manually by the team, so they appear when the stage actually happens — not at fixed times.
faq.q3: The status hasn’t changed in days. What should I do?
faq.a3: Clearance stages can stall. If the shipment is on hold, a notice with the reason appears in the last record. If there is no notice and you want to confirm, email [EMAIL] with the tracking number.
faq.q4: Can my customer abroad check the status?
faq.a4: Yes. The tracking page is public and only requires the number. Recipient details and declared values are not shown on it.
faq.q5: How do I create an account?
faq.a5: Accounts are created by our team when the first shipment is registered. You will receive an email to set your password.
faq.q6: How much does it cost and how long does it take?
faq.a6: [CLIENT TO SUPPLY — depends on the service and destination. Do not publish prices or transit times until confirmed in writing.]
faq.a7: The list of prohibited and restricted items is at [Prohibited items]. If in doubt about a specific item, ask before dispatching.
faq.a8: [CLIENT TO SUPPLY — who provides coverage, what it covers, what it excludes. Do not publish anything until confirmed in writing.]
